pages.tracingHelp: A trace represents a single function/api invocation. Traces contain observations.
pages.observationsHelp: An observation captures a single function call in an application. See docs to learn more.
pages.tracingSetupHelp: Setup tracing to track and analyze your LLM calls. You can create API keys and integrate Langfuse with your application.
pages.tracingEventsHelp: An observation captures a single function call in an application. This view uses the new ClickHouse events table.

setup.step1Description: You need to create an API key to start tracing your application. You can create more keys later in the project settings.
setup.step2Description: Langfuse relies on OpenTelemetry to instrument your application and export LLM application/agent traces to Langfuse. You can use one of our SDKs or 50+ framework integrations. Please follow the quickstart in the documentation to add Langfuse to your application.

detail.traceNotFoundMessage: The trace is either still being processed or has been deleted.
detail.traceNotFoundEventsMessage: No observations found for this trace. The trace may still be processing or has been deleted.
detail.noAccess: You do not have access to this trace.
